metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Health and Compliance defines the capability to continuously evaluate endpoint state against required security, configuration, and software posture expectations. Health reflects current conditions and is used as an input to access control, policy enforcement, and risk decisions. This pattern evaluates trust but does not enforce policy or remediate issues.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint health and compliance evaluation. Controls are intentionally scoped to assessment and signaling and exclude configuration enforcement and threat response.

components.title: Software State Compliance

components.title: Drift Detection

implemented-requirements.remarks: Detect configuration and software changes that cause drift.
